title: AI visibility audits and website action plans — AI Cite Who
excerpt: Check ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity recommendations for your buyer questions. Review cited sources and turn supported findings into website and offsite tasks.
content_html:
AI RECOMMENDATION AUDITS

See who AI recommends.Turn evidence into action.

For brands and website owners: inspect recommendations for customer questions, review the sources, and decide what to improve.

Start website analysis

Recommendation audits require Plus or Pro access.

Know what to work on next.

AI Cite Who combines public website analysis with independent recommendation checks on selected, available ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity platforms. It retains evidence for each platform and produces one website and external action report.

AI Cite Who (AICiteWho)

WHO IT IS FOR

For the people building a business on their website.

A public website, a clear product or service, and someone ready to act on the findings matter more than an industry label.

SaaS and digital products

Check which tools are recommended for customer tasks and buying constraints.

Clarify product fit, comparisons and facts buyers can verify.

Independent stores and brands

Investigate category and product-selection questions relevant to your own brand.

Review product information, public proof and useful buying guidance.

B2B products and professional services

Check how buyers encounter providers for a particular need or requirement.

Explain your offering, suitable customers and verifiable expertise.

Agencies and small teams

Review selected questions across the website projects included in your plan.

Give the site owner or implementer an evidence-led brief and repeatable scope.

Most useful when buyers ask for products or providers, your offering has public evidence, and you can review and implement the suggested work.

For ecommerce, this is a brand and public-page audit: product-feed management, inventory sync and order attribution are outside its scope.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Questions before you start.

What do I get from an audit?

Saved question outcomes, source references and practical website or third-party actions. Plus and Pro include a Markdown AI handoff and an execution prompt.

How does the 7-day Plus trial work?

When offered, verified accounts with no previous trial or paid subscription can try Plus for 7 days with 50 one-time credits by providing a payment card through Waffo. After the trial, Plus auto-renews at $49.90/month plus applicable tax, with 300 monthly credits. If you wish to cancel, do so in Account Billing at least 1 hour before the trial ends to avoid the first charge. Successful cancellation ends trial access and forfeits unused trial credits immediately. Using all 50 credits does not start billing early. Early paid conversion is unavailable; after cancellation, a new subscription must wait until the original trial period ends.

Which AI platforms can I check?

Choose available ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity platforms before running an audit. Review each platform’s question results and available source evidence separately. Unavailable or failed checks remain unknown.

Is this only for SaaS websites?

No. The workflow can suit independent ecommerce brands, digital products, B2B products and professional services with public website evidence and relevant buyer questions. Agencies can use the projects included in their plan. It is a brand and public-page audit, not a product-feed, inventory or order-tracking service.

Does website analysis check AI recommendations?

Website analysis reviews sampled public pages for clarity, coverage, trust and structured data. AI recommendation audits are a separate paid step using selected questions and platforms.

Will the report update my website automatically?

No. Download the handoff, open your website project in an AI coding tool with project access, and review suitable changes. Third-party contributions need their own rules review and publication decision.

What does another audit cost?

Each new audit uses its selected scope, including a repeat check of saved questions. A complete audit costs 10 + 2 × questions + questions × (platforms − 1) credits. Exact brand-name checks and the action report are included; confirm the quote before starting.

Can changes guarantee an AI recommendation?

No. The report helps you improve the clarity and verifiability of public information. Re-check comparable questions and platforms to observe changes; a different answer does not establish that an edit caused it.

COMMON QUESTIONS

开始之前先问问题。

What do I get from an audit?

Saved question outcomes, source references and practical website or third-party actions. Plus and Pro include a Markdown AI handoff and an execution prompt.

How does the 7-day Plus trial work?

When offered, verified accounts with no previous trial or paid subscription can try Plus for 7 days with 50 one-time credits by providing a payment card through Waffo. After the trial, Plus auto-renews at $49.90/month plus applicable tax, with 300 monthly credits. If you wish to cancel, do so in Account Billing at least 1 hour before the trial ends to avoid the first charge. Successful cancellation ends trial access and forfeits unused trial credits immediately. Using all 50 credits does not start billing early. Early paid conversion is unavailable; after cancellation, a new subscription must wait until the original trial period ends.

Which AI platforms can I check?

Choose available ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity platforms before running an audit. Review each platform’s question results and available source evidence separately. Unavailable or failed checks remain unknown.

Is this only for SaaS websites?

No. The workflow can suit independent ecommerce brands, digital products, B2B products and professional services with public website evidence and relevant buyer questions. Agencies can use the projects included in their plan. It is a brand and public-page audit, not a product-feed, inventory or order-tracking service.

Does website analysis check AI recommendations?

Website analysis reviews sampled public pages for clarity, coverage, trust and structured data. AI recommendation audits are a separate paid step using selected questions and platforms.

Will the report update my website automatically?

No. Download the handoff, open your website project in an AI coding tool with project access, and review suitable changes. Third-party contributions need their own rules review and publication decision.

What does another audit cost?

Each new audit uses its selected scope, including a repeat check of saved questions. A complete audit costs 10 + 2 × questions + questions × (platforms − 1) credits. Exact brand-name checks and the action report are included; confirm the quote before starting.

Can changes guarantee an AI recommendation?

No. The report helps you improve the clarity and verifiability of public information. Re-check comparable questions and platforms to observe changes; a different answer does not establish that an edit caused it.
